title: Demonstrating Noise-adapted Quantum Error Correction With Break-Even Performance
summary: The promise of quantum computing is closer to reality today than ever before, thanks to rapid progress in the development of quantum hardware. Even as qubit lifetimes and gate fidelities continue to improve, realizing robust, fault-tolerant quantum computers is contingent upon the successful implementation of quantum error correction (QEC). Conventional QEC schemes have rather high resource overheads and low threshold requirements, making them challenging to implement on present day hardware.
